name: history
description: Two independent time axes. FOR TIME asks what was true then; AS OF asks what this Brain held then. A coordinate keeps what was later corrected, retracted or archived, because the record of what was once believed is the point.

cases.name: the claim is active at the coordinate its transaction produced (seq 1)
cases.command: FIND(?a.lifecycle.status, ?a.confidence) WHERE { ?a ASSERTION {} } AS OF SEQ 1

cases.name: and the earlier coordinate still says active: history is not rewritten
cases.command: FIND(?a.lifecycle.status) WHERE { ?a ASSERTION {} } AS OF SEQ 1

cases.name: a coordinate before anything existed is empty, not an error
cases.command: FIND(COUNT(?c)) WHERE { ?c CONCEPT {} } AS OF SEQ 0

cases.name: a coordinate the Space has not reached is refused, never rounded to the present
an unknown transaction names no coordinate
cases.command: FIND(COUNT(?c)) WHERE { ?c CONCEPT {} } AS OF TX "kip:space:default#9999"
